title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
reason: Official FBI confirmation upgrades the earlier 'likely' attribution to confirmed, adds an actionable address list, and is corroborated by two sources.

sources.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.
US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.

title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
reason: Genuinely new development on the covered Binance hack: 90% of stolen funds reportedly replaced and specifics on how losses are absorbed.

sources.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.
